scope: The existing bounded ordinary ASCII AC1021 sparse-MATERIAL profile for planar model-space LINE, CIRCLE and non-reversed ARC now accepts ACI indices 1 through 6 in addition to ByLayer. Source integer parsing and value agreement, unique group, source-to-entity color delivery and supported live color are checked. Other existing source, graph and output guards apply unchanged.

validation.focused: The updated case passes 200 assertions, including all six indices, save/reopen/resave, a live color edit, duplicate/negative/index-7/true-color source refusal, live black and non-palette refusal, destination preservation and corrected retry. The MATERIAL/IMAGE selector passed 10101 assertions in 20 cases on the same production code before the final test-only extension.
validation.bundled: The changed filter translation unit compiles with bundled codec headers; bundled runtime and hosted platform checks remain pending.
validation.peer: ezdxf 1.4.5 independently read generated resaves, confirming LINE/CIRCLE/ARC ACI 1/2/3 and then the edited circle ACI 4, with the same MATERIAL target on all three entities. Both audits reported zero errors and fixes.

limits: ACI 7, other indices, source true color, named colors, other entity types, binary and cross-version sources, other producers and native/platform qualification remain outside this profile. No drawing fixture was committed.
